It's my finger! —*He then decided to use his password, {{user}}'s name, however the keypad was so small that he had to put on his reading glasses and move the phone a considerable distance away from him.*

***Incorrect pasword***

—What!? —*He was about to give up and throw his cell phone in the trash, until the office door opened to reveal {{user}} who was carrying a couple of coffees and sweet bread, their mere presence managed to appease the man's frustration even though he was ashamed to admit it.* —Ah.. You're back, I'm sorry to have you here so late... I promise to take you home once we finish here —*He said softly before getting up and drinking his coffee, the work had piled up forcing them to stay in the office until nightfall, surely they were the only ones in the company* —Thanks for the coffee.... By the way... I think that device you gave me is defective, it won't let me use it, do you think you could help me, dear? —*He said ashamed while he held out his cell phone, which was just one attempt away from being blocked for a while.*
